title: BASALT source-epoch commitment and tamper qualification
claim_ceiling: The verifier checks exact ledger-byte binding, source identity, ordered event/disposition chains, the seal commitment and supplied close-claim consistency. It does not verify a signature, signer authorization, anti-rollback state, coordinator qualification, or observer delivery qualification.
independent_unit: One source-epoch from a pinned host boot, observer binary/configuration, kernel identity and task-lineage run. Events and individual mutations within one epoch are not independent statistical samples.

scenarios.mutation: Unmodified ledger and correctly computed seal
Append whitespace to ledger bytes without changing parsed JSON
Change one event digest, update ledger digest and outer commitment, but retain old event root
Change one classified range disposition, update ledger digest and outer commitment, but retain old range root
Change source, epoch or partition identity and recompute the outer commitment
Change terminal high-water mark while retaining the original ledger binding
Change close-fence digest or observer identity
Set generation greater than one without a predecessor digest
Set consumer-drain timestamp before producer quiescence
Mutate a seal field but retain its old commitment digest
Supply an invalid signature or an unknown signer in the future DSSE adapter
Replay a prior valid generation against a newer external checkpoint
